info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Warehouse Inventory Transfer-v3-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Transfer API facilitates the management of inventory transfers between warehouses. This endpoint allows users to update existing transfer records, ensuring accurate inventory levels and optimizing warehouse operations. Typical consumers include supply chain managers and inventory specialists who need to maintain real-time visibility over inventory movements. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their logistics processes and improve operational efficiency.

put.description: This operation allows you to transfer inventory items from one location to another, updating the inventory records accordingly. Ensure that you have the correct item IDs and quantities specified in the request to execute the transfer successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for transferring inventory items. It should include all relevant information such as item identifiers, quantities, and destination details to successfully process the inventory transfer.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.
